CalendarReplyMailbox.description: The IMAP mailbox the caller's invitation replies are read from. The server only reads calendar replies in it and changes nothing in the mailbox. The password is never returned.

folder.description: Folder that is read, `INBOX` by default.

folderId.description: The folder's Mailbox id, as Mailbox/get (urn:wgw:jmap:mail) returns it.

trustedServer.description: Id of the mailbox's receiving server, learned from the newest messages when the settings are saved or tested. While it is known, a reply is applied only when that server's Authentication-Results header shows the sender is authenticated.

senderCheck.description: How a reply's sender is authenticated: `receiving_server` uses the trusted receiving server's Authentication-Results header; `dkim` (no trusted server known) verifies the reply's own DKIM signature against the signer's key in DNS.

active.description: False after repeated failed logins; saving the settings again turns reading back on.

lastError.description: `dns_unavailable`: the last check stopped at a reply whose DKIM key could not be looked up; it is tried again on the next check. `untrusted_server_unknown` is no longer reported and only remains on a mailbox until its next check.

port.description: 993 for ssl and 143 for starttls when left out.

password.description: Required on the first save. Left out or null keeps the stored password.

folderId.description: A Mailbox id from Mailbox/get; wins over `folder`. Looked up in the same login, 422 folder_missing when no folder has it.

MailMailbox.description: Mailbox/get (vendor urn:wgw:jmap:mail) object: the RFC 8621 §2 Mailbox properties a read-only IMAP folder can carry. Ids derive from the IMAP name.

MailMailboxRights.description: RFC 8621 §2 MailboxRights; only mayReadItems is true.

MailAccountCapability.description: Account object of urn:wgw:jmap:mail: the RFC 8621 §1.3.1 fields that apply to read-only Mailboxes.
